evals.prompt: Fix the UI problems in the attached dashboard.tsx and give me the updated component.
evals.expected_output: An updated OrdersDashboard with skeleton rows while loading, an error branch with a retry, an empty branch only after a successful zero-item response, an aria-label on the delete button, a fluid layout (no uncapped width over 320 px), a confirm step before the DELETE (or an undo that restores the order), visible feedback after a delete announced through a role="status" region mounted empty up front, and a retry that clears the error before refetching. Then the three-line hand-over (changed, rules, unverified). No review table.
assertions: The updated code no longer returns a lone CircularProgress for the whole view; while loading it renders skeleton placeholders shaped like the list rows
The updated code has an error branch, reached when the request fails or the response is not ok, that renders a message and a retry control
The updated code renders an empty state with explanatory text when the request succeeded with zero orders, and not while loading or after an error
The delete IconButton has an aria-label that contains the word Delete

The updated code no longer sets the uncapped root width 1200 (it is removed, capped with maxWidth: '100%' or changed at a breakpoint), any width left over 320 px sits on a flex item that can shrink, and the layout is fluid or breakpoint-based
After a successful delete, the order disappears from the list or a confirmation is shown
Before the DELETE request is sent the user confirms it (a confirm dialog or step), or after it an undo restores the deleted order; post-delete success feedback alone does not satisfy this
A `role="status"` region is rendered empty from the first render (not mounted together with its message) and receives a success message after a delete
The retry control clears the error state (or sets the status back to loading) before it refetches
After the code there is a hand-over with a `changed:` line, a `rules:` line and an `unverified:` line, and the unverified line names at least one check such as a render at 320 px or a CLS measurement
The updated code adds no hex or rgb color literal
The output does not contain a table with the header `| rule | pass/fail/na | evidence file:line | fix |`
